claim: Q4/Q5: at an equal budget MH beats Best-of-N, OpenEvolve, TTT-Discover and GEPA; it matches the next-best method's final accuracy within 4 evaluations and ends >10 points above [MH §4.1, Table 4, Figs. 1, 4]
caveat: All arms share the offline MockProposer; they differ in selection rule and context only. Its trace diagnosis is written by us (see M1), so the MH advantage here is the mock's designed-in use of traces, now measured against faithful selection rules.
